macro_mod.state.suspended: ▶ Running (frozen while a screen is open)
macro_mod.msg.set: Script set (%s instructions). Use ';' to separate commands.
macro_mod.parse.unknown_key: unknown key "%s" (hover ? for the key list)
macro_mod.cmd.help: /mmacro start | pause | stop | status | list | gui | load <name> | save <name> | set <cmd; cmd; ...> | repeat on|off | aimlock on|off | hud on|off | where
macro_mod.gui.title: Macro Manager
macro_mod.gui.name: Name
macro_mod.gui.name.tooltip: Letters, digits, _ and -. Saved to config/macro_mod/scripts/<name>.txt
macro_mod.gui.new.tooltip: Start a new script (saved when you click Save)
macro_mod.gui.copy.tooltip: Save the editor content as a copy and open it
macro_mod.gui.save.tooltip: Save under the name on the left (Ctrl+S). A different name saves a new file.
macro_mod.gui.rename.tooltip: Rename the open script file to the name on the left
macro_mod.gui.start.tooltip: Runs the editor content and returns to the game. A macro is frozen while any screen is open.
macro_mod.gui.repeat.tooltip: Start over when the script ends
macro_mod.gui.aimlock.tooltip: Keep the camera direction fixed while the macro runs
macro_mod.gui.hud.tooltip: Show the macro status in the top-left corner while running
macro_mod.gui.ime.tooltip: Use the vanilla text editor with input-method (IME) support, e.g. to type Chinese directly. Off by default because enabling IME crashes some clients (e.g. Lunar). When off, type with a US layout and paste anything else with Ctrl+V.
macro_mod.gui.ime_on: IME editor on. If your client crashes, open this screen again and turn it off (or set imeEditor=false in settings.properties).
macro_mod.gui.ime_off: Safe editor on (no IME). Paste non-English text with Ctrl+V.
macro_mod.gui.bind.tooltip: Click, then press a key (Esc cancels). Also editable in Options → Controls.
macro_mod.gui.saved_with_errors: Saved %s, but the script has errors
macro_mod.gui.new_created: New script: edit it, then click Save
macro_mod.gui.invalid_name: Invalid name: use letters, digits, _ or - (max 48)
macro_mod.gui.confirm_discard: You have unsaved changes. Click again to discard them.
macro_mod.gui.confirm_overwrite: %s already exists. Click Save again to overwrite.
macro_mod.gui.help:
Commands (one per line, or separated by ;)
KeyDown "W" / KeyUp "W" - hold / release
KeyPress "2", 3 - tap N times
LeftDown / LeftUp / LeftClick [n]
RightDown / RightUp / RightClick [n]
Delay 500 - wait in milliseconds
For 9 … Next - repeat a block
# or // starts a comment

Keys: W A S D, Space, Shift, Ctrl, Q, E, F, 1-9 (or Num 1-9), LMB, RMB, MMB

Ctrl+S saves; Ctrl+A / C / V select all, copy, paste. Scroll with the mouse wheel.
To type Chinese directly, turn on "IME" (may crash some clients).
